import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int x = sc.nextInt();
        int y = sc.nextInt();
        int n = sc.nextInt();

        final double inf = 99999999;
        double mn = inf;
        int ra = 0, rb = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            int tx = (int)Math.round(1.0 * x * i / y - 0.0000001);
            double diff = Math.abs((1.0 * x / y) - (1.0 * tx / i));
            if (diff < mn) {
                ra = tx;
                rb = i;
                mn = diff;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(ra + "/" + rb);
        sc.close();
    }
}
